proposal.diagnosis: processPayment ran chargeCustomer and markOrderPaid concurrently using Promise.all, which causes the order to be marked as paid even if charging the customer fails.
proposal.strategy: Revert to awaiting chargeCustomer before calling markOrderPaid so that orders are only marked paid upon a successful charge.
proposal.intentNote: The PR intent was to run charging and marking as paid concurrently, but marking as paid depends on charging succeeding first.
